RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_expec.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_expect_error

  (∀ r ≤ m, |(RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.falling (X ω) r) - μ ^ r| ≤ ε * μ ^ r) →
    |(RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.bonferroni m (X ω)) -
          ∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m, (-1) ^ r * ↑(r - 1) * μ ^ r / ↑r.factorial| ≤

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_produ.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_product_expect_error

  (∀ (r s : ℕ),
      r + s ≤ 2 * m →
        |(RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.falling (X ω) r * RiffleLowerV2.falling (Y ω) s) -
              μ ^ r * ν ^ s| ≤
          ε * μ ^ r * ν ^ s) →
    |(RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.bonferroni m (X ω) * RiffleLowerV2.bonferroni m (Y ω)) -
          (∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m, (-1) ^ r * ↑(r - 1) * μ ^ r / ↑r.factorial) *
            ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m, (-1) ^ s * ↑(s - 1) * ν ^ s / ↑s.factorial| ≤
      (ε * ∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m, ↑(r - 1) * μ ^ r / ↑r.factorial) *
        ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m, ↑(s - 1) * ν ^ s / ↑s.factorial

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.column_log_facto.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.column_log_factorial_bound
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.column_log_facto.type:

  0 < c →
    0 < N →
      ∑ a : Fin k, m a = R →
        (∀ (a : Fin k), 0 < m a → c * ↑N ≤ ↑(n a)) →
          2 * ↑R ≤ c * ↑N →
            0 < ∏ a : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.falling (n a) (m a) ∧
              0 < ∏ a : Fin k, ↑(n a) ^ m a ∧
                |Real.log ((∏ a : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.falling (n a) (m a)) / ∏ a : Fin k, ↑(n a) ^ m a)| ≤
                  ↑R ^ 2 / (c * ↑N)

              (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) =
            RiffleLowerV2.Targets.residualWordMean cuts p w
